A woman in pink pants is partially visible on the left side, sitting on the edge of the cart or a nearby bench. The background features a blue building with windows and some greenery.

The connection point where the steering wheel meets the dashboard/column is vague and lacks clear mechanical definition, appearing to float slightly rather than being rigidly attached.
The geometry of the window frames in the background blue building is slightly warped and inconsistent, suggesting minor generative blur or perspective distortion.
